# Security Policy

Aux Proton Drive Bridge handles cloud storage workflows on Linux desktops. Treat vulnerability reports as sensitive.

## Supported versions

| Version | Status |
|---|---|
| 0.3.x | Active |
| 0.2.x | Security fixes while 0.3.x is current |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report privately:

- **Email:** [security@auxillo.tech](mailto:security@auxillo.tech)
- **Website:** [auxillo.tech](https://auxillo.tech)

Include when safe:

- affected version or commit
- operating system and package format
- reproduction steps
- security impact
- whether credentials, tokens, local paths, or remote files are involved
- suggested mitigation if known

Do not include real Proton passwords, recovery phrases, 2FA codes, session tokens, or customer data. Use local fixtures or redacted evidence.

## Security model

The detailed security model is in [`docs/SECURITY.md`](docs/SECURITY.md).
